channel.title: Recommended Media on metafunctor
channel.description: A curated collection of books, papers, lectures, and courses that have shaped my thinking about computation, mathematics, intelligence, and the nature of mind.

item.title: A Formal Theory of Inductive Inference
item.dc:creator: Alex Towell
item.description: Notes Foundational paper on algorithmic probability and universal induction. Basis for AIXI.

item.title: A Philosophy of Software Design
item.dc:creator: Alex Towell
item.description: Notes Deep modules, complexity management. Best modern design book.

item.title: Against Method
item.dc:creator: Alex Towell
item.description: Notes Epistemological anarchism. The strongest critique of scientific method.

item.title: An Introduction to Statistical Learning (ISLR2)
item.dc:creator: Alex Towell
item.description: Notes Best practical stats-based ML introduction ever written.

item.title: An Introduction to Thermal Physics
item.dc:creator: Alex Towell
item.description: Notes Thermodynamics + statistical mechanics at the right level.

item.title: API Design Patterns
item.dc:creator: Alex Towell
item.description: Notes Practical patterns for designing internal and public APIs.

item.title: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach
item.dc:creator: Alex Towell
item.description: Notes The standard AI textbook. Search, logic, planning, learning, language.

item.title: Attention Is All You Need
item.dc:creator: Alex Towell
item.description: Notes Introduced the Transformer architecture. The paper that started everything.

item.title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
item.dc:creator: Alex Towell
item.description: Notes Bidirectional pre-training via masked language modeling. Defined the pre-train/fine-tune paradigm.

item.title: Book of Proof
item.dc:creator: Alex Towell
item.description: Notes Bridge from computation to proof. Sets, logic, induction, functions.

item.title: Building Effective Agents
item.dc:creator: Alex Towell
item.description: Notes Patterns for building AI agents: tool use, orchestration, evaluation.

item.title: Calculus Made Easy
item.dc:creator: Alex Towell
item.description: Notes Still the gentlest and most irreverent intro to calculus ever written.

item.title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models
item.dc:creator: Alex Towell
item.description: Notes Step-by-step reasoning via prompting. Unlocked a new capability class.

item.title: Classical Mechanics
item.dc:creator: Alex Towell
item.description: Notes The cleanest Newton → Lagrange → Hamilton pipeline.

item.title: Claude Agent SDK
item.dc:creator: Alex Towell
item.description: Notes Build custom agents using Claude’s tool-use and agentic capabilities programmatically.

item.title: Claude Code Custom Slash Commands
item.dc:creator: Alex Towell
item.description: Notes Create reusable slash commands and skills with YAML frontmatter and markdown prompts.

item.title: Claude Code Documentation
item.dc:creator: Alex Towell
item.description: Notes Official reference for Claude Code CLI — commands, configuration, hooks, MCP servers.

item.title: Claude Code Hooks
item.dc:creator: Alex Towell
item.description: Notes Event-driven automation: PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop hooks for custom workflows.

item.title: Claude Code IDE Integration
item.dc:creator: Alex Towell
item.description: Notes Using Claude Code inside VS Code and JetBrains IDEs as a coding assistant.

item.title: Claude Code MCP Integration
item.dc:creator: Alex Towell
item.description: Notes Model Context Protocol servers for external tool and service integration.
